payload.title: Feedback optimization toolchain improvements
payload.description:
Purpose: Improve the generic Plexus feedback optimization toolchain so operators and agents can discover worthwhile work, run reproducible optimizations, validate candidates, and complete unattended workflows safely.

Exclusions:
- Client-specific scorecard, score, evaluation, optimization, incident, and performance information.
- Application behavior changes in this administrative setup issue.
- Deployment work already owned by another active session.

Definition of Done:
- Seven focused epics cover discovery, cohorts, candidate safety, execution, observability, parallel orchestration, and supported runtime integration.
- Existing sanitized issue histories are preserved and reparented without duplication.
- Dependencies and concurrency boundaries allow independent worktrees and parallel agents.
- Kanbus hierarchy validation and confidentiality review pass.

Running log: Record decisions, progress, failures, outcomes, and next steps in sanitized Kanbus comments only.
